instruction.text: Lucy is reading about the best way to get to the airport. Read the text and fill the correct adverbs in order to make the text flow better.

atoms.b: ((++Firstly Secondly)), check your flight time and that you have your passport before departing!
((Firstly ++Secondly)), check the quickest route to get to the airport.

atoms.b: Hi Alexa! Tell me ((++quickly fastly)) about your journey to school!

((++Then, Finally,)) we walk along the road until we ((alternatively ++eventually)) arrive at the traffic lights.
Lucy and I then walk along the road and cut through the park. ((++Alternatively, Maybe,)) we could go around the park, however we do this very ((++rarely often)).
((++Finally, Firstly,)) we walk straight on and get to the school gates where our day starts!
